verdict: Penang laksa is the lighter choice. Its sour broth with no santan saves an estimated 200 kcal compared to curry laksa.
why: Penang laksa is an estimated 450 kcal. Curry laksa is an estimated 650 kcal.
Penang laksa has only an estimated 7 g fat. Curry laksa has an estimated 36 g, mostly from santan (coconut milk).
Protein is about the same, an estimated 20 g vs 22 g. So you don't lose much in terms of fullness.
Rich santan broth is easy to slurp until it's all gone. The sour broth is lighter even if you drink all of it.
when_a: Penang laksa suits a normal lunch. Be careful with the petis (prawn paste), use just enough for taste.
when_b: Curry laksa is okay once in a while. Leave some broth in the bowl.
tip: For any laksa, eat the noodles and toppings first. No need to finish all the broth, especially santan broth.

faq.q: Is the petis in Penang laksa high in calories?
faq.a: Petis contains sugar. One normal spoonful isn't much, but if you keep adding more, the calories can go up.

faq.q: Is curry laksa completely off-limits on a diet?
faq.a: No. Have a normal bowl, drink less of the broth, and choose lighter food for your other meals that day.
